notes.title: I can’t keep going with this school!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/ed56f2b6b92b28154b6c70a8888abfe5540b80ce.jpg"][/img]Although I’m not good at art, anatomy requires sketching.
My goal is to draw corpses as lifelike as living humans.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/3e071990ffefa2d663722b347247b46fb3d93de1.jpg"][/img]The school values students’ musical interests.
Just that some piano keys keep disappearing…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/5e1fccfaa914fec5fabe1fd9b00d8d91c64947a5.jpg"][/img]Look at these animal models the students made — so cute.
Though a bit factory-like, these machines are specially trained and completely safe.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/99c15c33f717ee8a69adc3aeace7d8f18ca55e3c.jpg"][/img]The tour ends here. Please continue exploring on your own!
Now everyone waits here; the Director will give an important speech shortly.[/p][p](One hour later… still no Director)[/p][p]The Director has urgent business. The important speech is postponed, time will be notified later.
You may leave; please remain quiet![/p]

notes.title: Help! This new school is terrifying...
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/ccbfa7f0bc79bdda803295f6750c23c73f8e623a.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/e579792328899697b4ef5c46c405c1f3979e73c3.jpg"][/img]What? You say there’s someone at the far end of the corridor?
Nonsense, there’s absolutely nobody there![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/edca7c648e398948533ddea85862d7890a6cbecd.jpg"][/img]These terminals are just empty shells unless connected to the server.
New students are the same… the senior just stands there, smirking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/51ab74b79616a9fc8c6f265b44eb3a9677223f05.jpg"][/img]Chemistry experiments are safe, and you’ll learn a lot.
Pay attention to the instructions, the teacher absolutely won’t harm you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/473d614042c57853295a38873644d45e32c1e052.jpg"][/img]All for science, the specimens here die as they should.
Such spirit is noble and worth learning.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/03a0089e01b565c74606355f49ca085f8bf895ab.jpg"][/img]The school is very considerate. Don’t worry about accidents; if something happens, the nurse will take care of you.[/p][p]Besides these science classrooms, the school also has various art classrooms.
Next time, we’ll visit them…[/p]

notes.title: First Day of School… Senior’s Tour…
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/d883c863a748e8a29f44acb65bd8e0086e5ea9f3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/f1d7e50e72ebdfdfa06957f30b30a6b1022b709b.jpg"][/img]As you can see, this is an old building.
If you hear strange noises in the hallway… don’t mind them.
Don’t worry, you’ll get used to it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/81710d0a47d943e4b41e7a543f305e1ebe2b6604.jpg"][/img]The best place for meditation. The mirrors here will show “you,” but sometimes… not.
Don’t be nervous, the steam makes everything a little blurry, just look carefully.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/8b76968d056b4e1e2a722f46e5cf7f6e80bd5ccc.jpg"][/img]The school is very safe. These windows have sturdy bars to keep bad people out…
Of course, you can’t get out either.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/9251a4ea8398660e7c9b61794ca4e46325f7a71b.jpg"][/img]Spacious and bright… oh, forgot to turn on the lights…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/c0eccf52818aac9b20d5cbdf148206dc3bbdacd8.jpg"][/img]The classroom is spacious and bright, perfect for lessons or self-study.
The Director will observe your attentiveness from the back door, so please stay disciplined.
Otherwise, individual instruction is unavoidable.[/p][p]That’s today’s “Freshman Welcome Tour.”
The lessons… might start tonight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701160/3b43898079e7d5587002c029c5f4fdb97afd557c.jpg"][/img]Next time we’ll go upstairs, and I’ll show you the labs and other places.[/p]
